title: [Shopify] Make codeunit 30272 "Shpfy Update Price Source" public
summary: Codeunit 30272 "Shpfy Update Price Source" is now public, allowing partners to reference it for custom Shopify price calculation logic through explicit bind/unbind subscriptions.
key_points: Partners can now use BindSubscription on this codeunit to apply their custom pricing logic
The codeunit only reads non-sensitive Shop configuration data
Making it public does not auto-activate subscriptions; partners must explicitly bind them
Internal getters on the pricing calculator remain restricted
Enables customization of Shopify connector price calculations through the existing event subscriber pattern
